spans.s:
r. 7th cl. (भुनक्ति भुंक्ते)
1 To save, to cherish or protect.
2 To eat.
3 To enjoy.
4 To suffer or endure.
(ओ, ञौ) ओभुजौ r. 6th cl. (भुजति)
To bend, to make crooked.

mf. (-जः-जा)
1 The arm.
2 The hand.
3 The arm or leg of a geometrical figure, as a square or triangle.
4 A bending, a curve.
E.
भुज to bend, aff. क.

m. (-रः)
The armpit.
E.
भुज the arm, and कोटर a hollow.

m. (-गः)
A snake.
E.
भुज a curve, and ग who goes.

m. (-णः)
The bird of VIṢṆU.
E.
भुजग a snake, and दारण destroyer; this word, and similar compounds, may be applied equally to any of the natural enemies of the serpent race, as the ardea, the peacock, the ichneumon, &c. ut infra.

m. (-कः)
GARUḌA, the bird of VIṢṆU.
E.
भुजग a snake, and अन्तक destroyer: see the last.

m. (-जी)
A peacock.
E.
भुजग a snake, and आभोजिन् who eats: see भुजगदारण.

m. (-नः)
GARUḌA.
E.
भुजग a snake, and अशन food.

m. (-ङ्गः)
1 A snake.
2 A catamite, a lecher.
f. (-ङ्गी)
A female snake.
E.
भुज a curve, गम to go, खच् aff.; also भुजङ्गम.

f. (-नी)
A plant considered as an antidote, commonly Kaṅkālika, and said to be a sort of mustard (?).
E.
भुजङ्ग a snake, घातिनी destructive.

n. (-तं)
A species of the Jagatī metre.

m. (-क्)
1 The bird and vehicle of VIṢṆ

A peacock.
E.
भुजङ्ग a snake, and भुज् who eats.

m. (-जी)
The large Indian serpent, (Böa constrictor.)
E.
भुजङ्ग a snake, and भोजिन् who eats; devouring the smaller races.

m. (-मः)
A snake.
E.
भुज bending, गम to go, and खच् aff.; also भुजग, and भुजङ्ग.

n. (-तं)
A species of the Utkṛti metre.

m. (-शुः)
A species of the Vṛhatī metre.

f. (-ता)
Another species of the Vṛhatī metre.

m. (-हा)
GARUḌA.
E.
भुजङ्ग a snake, and हन् who kills: see भुजङ्गदारण.

f. (-क्षी)
A plant, (the ichneumon plant): see रास्ना.
E.
भुजङ्ग a snake, अक्ष to pervade, affs. अण् and ङीप्; otherwise भुजङ्ग and अक्ष an eye; the flowers being compared to the eye of the snake.

m. (-ख्यः)
A plant, (Mesua ferrea.)
E.
भुजङ्ग a snake, and आख्या a name.

n. (-रः)
The shoulder, the shoulder blade.
E.
भुज the arm, शिरस् the head.

m. (-ण्टः)
A finger nail.
E.
भुजा the hand, and कण्ट a thorn.

m. (-लः)
A hand.
E.
भुजा the arm, and दल a leaf.

n. (-रं)
The breast, the chest.
E.
भुज the arm, and अन्तर intervening.

m. (-डः)
Clasping or enfolding in the arms.
E.
भुज, and आपीड pressing.

m. (-जिः)
Fire.
E.
भुज to eat, इ Uṇādi aff.

mf. (-ष्यः-ष्या)
A servant, a slave.
m. (-ष्यः)
1 An independant man.
2 A string worn round the wrist.
(-ष्या)
A harlot, a whore.
E.
भुज to be crooked, Uṇādi aff. किष्यन्.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Being enjoyed or possessed.
2 Being eaten.
E.
भुज to enjoy, pass. v., शानच् aff.

m. (-ज्युः)
Eating.
E.
भुज to eat, युक् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-न्तुः)
An earth-worm.
E.
भू, and जन्तु a being.

Wheat.
2

The fruit of the Vikaṅkaṭa, (Flacourtia sapida.)
E.
भू the earth, and जम्बू rose apple.
